snippets.code:
We are refining the UI/UX and features of our self-hosted streaming portal. Please analyze the repository and implement the following specific updates cleanly across the codebase:

Task 1: Logo & Layout Verification
- Verify the header implementation of the Westmont Hub logo element. Ensure it is aligned properly with the global theme toggle switch at the top of the interface.

Task 2: Lesson Dashboard Code Snippet Container
- Update the student video dashboard layout to include a dedicated "Code Snippet & Resource" container directly underneath each lesson video player.
- This section must beautifully render code blocks, system commands, or prompt text lines that I configure as an admin.
- Include a sleek "Copy to Clipboard" utility button directly next to or inside this snippet container for seamless student use.

Task 3: Modern Golden Glassmorphism Button Styles
- Completely redesign all action buttons across the entire application to feature a premium, modern "glassmorphism" look (subtle blur, frosted overlay, translucent faded styling).
- Color Transition Requirements:
  * Dark Mode: Buttons must feature a dark, rich golden glass gradient shifting gracefully using the #e78943 palette tones over a translucent frosted background.
  * Light Mode: When toggling to White background theme, the buttons must remain distinctly golden, but dynamically mix/blend their frosted transparency against the clean white backing container.
- Use CSS properties like `background: rgba(...)`, `backdrop-filter: blur(...)`, and custom borders to achieve this premium glass aesthetic.

Scan our CSS files, layout templates, and dashboard view structures to apply these design and component enhancements now.
